answer: In the Singapore Model AI Governance Framework 2nd Edition, repeatability refers to the internal repetition of results within one's organization, meaning that the same team can consistently perform an action or make a decision given the same scenario. On the other hand, reproducibility refers to the ability of an independent verification team to produce the same results using the same AI method based on the documentation provided by the organization. Thus, repeatability is about consistency within the same team and setup, while reproducibility involves independent verification across different teams or setups.
